title: Longcat2 launch marks China’s 1.6T AI model breakthrough #Longcat2 #AItraining #ChineseAI
description: Meituan released Longcat2, a 1.6 trillion parameter AI model designed for advanced agent tasks, tool calling, coding, and handling long multi-step processes. Despite its massive size, it remains efficient and cost-effective by activating only a small part of the network per token. Longcat2's training used around 50,000 domestically produced Chinese chips, marking the largest model training run without Nvidia hardware involvement. This milestone emphasizes China's growing independence in AI infrastructure and hardware capabilities. Unlike Western counterparts like OpenAI and Anthropic, which restrict access to their models, China continues to push AI development openly, contributing models like DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, and now Longcat2. This openness fosters innovation and broad access in the rapidly evolving AI landscape. #Meituan #Longcat2 #ChineseAI #AIModelTraining #AIHardware #NvidiaAlternative #OpenAI #Anthropic #DeepSeek #Qwen #Kimi #GLM #AIInnovation #AIResearch #ArtificialIntelligence
